auditor_value: Ball: weight w₂ at the centre; wall's normal reaction (horizontal, through the centre); ground's normal reaction (vertical, through the centre); stick's normal reaction at C (perpendicular to the stick, through the centre); ground friction on the ball = 0 because every other force passes through the centre, so any friction would be the only force with a moment about it. Stick: weight w₁ at its midpoint; ball's normal reaction at C (perpendicular to the stick); ground's normal reaction and friction at B; nothing at A.
notes: Force lists for both bodies, the radial-normal argument and the zero-friction torque argument all agree with mine. The solution does not state the direction of the ground friction on the stick at B (toward the wall); not filed, as the question asks for a sketch and the force list is complete.
